## Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): electron n = +3.2×10¹², hole n = −1.2×10¹²

Run 6 (`data/6`): B 0 → 10 T at (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V. Run 7 (`data/7`): B 10 → 0.3 T at (−0.280, −0.463) V. Both complete, sr1 at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS), I = 10 nA. Model frequencies from the run-5 calibration: full-density (4-fold) F_L = 33.1 T (electron) / 12.4 T (hole); ABAB two-band partition ≈ (7.5, 25.6) T / (5.3, 7.1) T; ABCA = one heavy tone at F_L, LK-suppressed at T_e ≈ 8 K.

# Runs 6 + 7 - SdH spot checks (raw first, then FFT/onset). R = (sr1_X/gain)/I_drain.
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

MODEL = {6: dict(FL=33.1, abab=(7.5, 25.6), label="electron n=+3.2e12"),
         7: dict(FL=12.4, abab=(5.3, 7.1), label="hole n=-1.2e12")}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 7))
for k, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    r = run(rid)
    ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field")
    I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain               # measured drain current, A
    R = (r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I         # Rxx B_1-B_2, Ohm
    srt = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[srt], R[srt]        # run 7 swept descending
    print(f"=== run {rid} ({MODEL[rid]['label']}): {len(B)} pts, B {B[0]:.2f}->{B[-1]:.2f} T, "
          f"R {R.min():.1f}..{R.max():.1f} Ohm, interrupted={r.interrupted}")

    ax[k, 0].plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
    ax[k, 0].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ohm)", title=f"run {rid} raw - {MODEL[rid]['label']}")

    try:
        o = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9)   # 50 uV sens at 10 nA
        print(o.summary())
        onset = o.onset_b
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print(f"sdh_onset FAILED: {e}"); onset = 3.0

    for blo in sorted({max(onset, 1.5), 3.0, 4.5}):
        f, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(blo, B.max()), log=False)
        s = sp[0] / sp[0].max()
        ax[k, 1].plot(f, s, lw=0.8, label=f"B in [{blo:.1f}, {B.max():.0f}] T")
        top = sorted(zip(s, f), reverse=True)[:5]
        print(f"  FFT b_lo={blo:.1f}: top freqs " + ", ".join(f"{ff:.1f} T ({ss:.2f})" for ss, ff in top))
    m = MODEL[rid]
    ax[k, 1].axvline(m["FL"], color="k", ls="--", lw=0.8, alpha=0.6)
    for x in m["abab"]:
        ax[k, 1].axvline(x, color="r", ls="--", lw=0.8, alpha=0.6)
    ax[k, 1].set(xlim=(0, 60), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="FFT (norm)",
                 title=f"run {rid} SdH FFT (black dash F_L, red dash ABAB two-band model)")
    ax[k, 1].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.tight_layout()

**Read:** Both spot checks show strong, light-mass, multi-frequency SdH — **inconsistent with single-band ABCA** at these densities, **leaning ABAB**, with ABCB not yet excluded.

- **Run 7 (hole, F_L = 12.4 T)** is the cleaner read: two non-harmonic fundamentals at ≈ **5.3 and 7.0 T** (FFT, B 1.5–10 T; onset tracker finds 4.7/6.6 T with 2×/3×/4× ladders, plus a 12.3 T tone at SNR 124). The pair **sums to 12.3 ≈ F_L** — two Fermi pockets sharing the full density at 4-fold degeneracy, matching the ABAB two-band model (5.3, 7.1 T) almost exactly; the 12.3 T tone sits at the pair sum (magnetic-breakdown / total-FS orbit). ABCA predicts a single 12.4 T heavy tone that should be LK-dead at T_e ≈ 8 K; instead oscillations are strong from 0.7 T (light mass).
- **Run 6 (electron, F_L = 33.1 T)**: dominant light tone at **7.1 T** (SNR 40, persists to the 0.3 T record edge) with harmonics 14.1/22.1/29.5 flagged at 2×/3×/4×; secondary content at 9.5 T and high-B FFT weight near 24–33 T that the coarse window resolution (ΔF ≈ 8 T for B 4.5–10 T) cannot separate from the harmonic ladder. At 4-fold degeneracy the 7.1 T pocket carries only 1.1×10¹² of the 3.2×10¹² total — most of the density sits in one or more heavier pockets, i.e. a multi-band FS here too.
- Caveat: run 7 rode a sustained **−103 pA** TG current (V_tg = −0.28 V) vs ~0 pA in run 6 (V_tg = +0.98 V) — a small negative-V_tg offset/leak, far under the 1 nA trip; expect the same signature on the fan's hole-side half-rows.

**Next:** the Landau fan at D = 0 (plan step 4) — the ν-line slopes and the LL-crossing pattern separate genuine second bands from harmonics and give the filling-factor sequence for the ABAB-vs-ABCB call.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), n = −1.25 → +3.24×10¹², B 0.2 → 10 T

> **05:27** · landau-fan: D=0 line (run-5 cal), fast n -1.25..+3.24e12 205 pts co-swept (Vtg,Vbg); slow B 0.2..10.0 T 0.1 T asc, 99 rows; sr1 200 uV (20 kOhm FS), I=10 nA, fast\_delay 1.0 · **ETA ~12:42** (≈7h15m)

**Why (plan step 4):** the spot checks (runs 6/7, ana read) show multi-band light-mass SdH on both carrier signs — ABCA is disfavored, and the ABAB-vs-ABCB call now needs the fan: ν-line slopes and intercepts (harmonics have no independent ν lines), the LL-crossing pattern (two bilayer-like bands → a crossing lattice), the filling sequence, and the CNP gap vs B.

**Geometry:** fast axis = co-swept (V_tg, V_bg) along the run-5-calibrated D = 0 line (`multimegasweep`), n = −1.25 → +3.24×10¹² cm⁻² in 205 pts (Δn ≈ 0.022×10¹²; V_tg −0.291 → +0.995 V, V_bg −0.484 → +1.181 V, asserted inside the validators). Slow axis = B, 0.2 → 10.0 T in 0.1 T steps (99 rows), ascending from the parked 0 T (magnet never re-traverses; ends at 10 T). Si gate stays 0.

**Coverage trade:** hole side stops at n = −1.25×10¹² — the TG −0.3 V limit ends the D = 0 line there (full coverage is not purchasable inside the committed box). D ≠ 0 is not covered by this run; a D ≠ 0 fan riding B back down is the contingency if crossings are ambiguous (plan step 5a).

**Settings:** sr1 sensitivity 200 µV → 20 kΩ FS at 10 nA (run-5 lesson: size to the gapped-CNP expectation — B = 0 CNP peak 330 Ω, ν = 0 grows steeply with B; railing accepted only at the highest-B CNP points, censoring gap magnitude there, never ν-line positions). fast_delay 1.0 s = run-5 precedent (3.3 τ at τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct — below the 7–10 τ floor, bent knowingly: single sweep direction makes the filter lag a constant ~2-pt shift along n, slopes unaffected). slow_delay 3 s. Leak guard trips at 1 nA; T guard trips above 1.8 K.

**Expected warnings:** sustained ≈ −100 pA TG current on the negative-V_tg half of each row (run-7 signature, benign) — hera-watch LEAK lines there are expected; the trip is 10× above it.

**Price:** 99 rows × (205 × 0.945 s [run-5 cal] + ~4 s flyback + ~47 s ramp+settle) ≈ 6.8 h nominal; with the session's 5–10 % overrun evidence → **≈ 7 h 15 m**. Ends at B = 10 T, gates at n = +3.24×10¹².

**Checkpoints:** first rows (~15 min): rail/leak/dead-channel + CNP peak visible per row; ~2 T (~1.5 h): partial fan re-form — ν lines emerging, sensitivity verdict; ~5 T (~4 h): interim crossing-pattern read — continue / abandon (an abort at 5 T still leaves a usable 0.2–5 T fan; the 5–10 T half prices at ~3.5 h).

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): fast (Vtg, Vbg) co-swept, n -1.25 -> +3.24e12 (205); slow B 0.2 -> 10 T (99) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.25, 3.24, 205)            # 1e12 cm^-2, dn ~ 0.022
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, 0.0, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max())
assert Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.2, 10.0001, 0.1), 4)  # ascending from parked 0 T
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
print(f"fast: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts): Vtg [{Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vtg_vec.max():+.4f}], "
      f"Vbg [{Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vbg_vec.max():+.4f}] V; slow: B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T ({len(B_vec)} rows)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts at 0.2), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0
I_TRIP, T_TRIP = 1e-9, 1.8
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 200 uV = 20 kOhm FS at 10 nA (gapped-CNP headroom; run-5 lesson).
sr1.sensitivity(200e-6)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (20 kOhm FS); sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; "
      f"tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan D=0: fast co-swept (Vtg,Vbg) n -1.25..+3.24e12 (205 pts), slow B 0.2..10 T (99 rows, 0.1 T), "
                  "sr1 200 uV, fast_delay 1.0; cal run 5")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 line (run-5 cal: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}); '
              f'fast n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12, 205 pts (Vtg {Vtg_vec.min():+.3f}..{Vtg_vec.max():+.3f}, Vbg {Vbg_vec.min():+.3f}..{Vbg_vec.max():+.3f}); '
              f'slow B 0.2 -> 10.0 T, 0.1 T, ascending; Vsi = 0; T = {_T0:.2f} K')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def fan_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg, t_s = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6])), float(data[4])
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP or t_s > T_TRIP:
        print(f"GUARD TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f} V: "
              f"|I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A, T={t_s:.3f} K")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                 slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
# end state: B = 10 T, gates at n = +3.24e12 — next step rides the field down (never re-traverse); no park.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K")
